$comment: Geometry recipes (pipeline/transit_pipeline/past.py): the San Francisco & North Pacific off today's SMART track, from OpenHistoricalMap's ways (ohm.py), checked on the USGS sheets.

sfnp-tiburon-larkspur.note: Cut at SMART's Larkspur station, where the line joins today's track. OpenHistoricalMap's ways were traced from the 1895 and 1897 15-minute sheets; the 1948 and 1954 sheets show the track while it still carried freight

sfnp-windsor-grants.note: Cut at SMART's Windsor station and at Grant as the 1940 sheet labels it. OpenHistoricalMap's way lies within about 12 m of today's track (the federal rail network's centerline, as BAM draws SMART's extension)

sfnp-grants-healdsburg.note: Cut at Grant and at Healdsburg as the 1940 sheet labels them

sfnp-healdsburg-cloverdale.note: Cut at Healdsburg as the 1940 sheet labels it; OpenHistoricalMap's way ends at Cloverdale, where its 1889 extension begins. Within about 12 m of today's track, except near Cloverdale (up to about 300 m)

sfnp-guerneville-branch.note: OpenHistoricalMap's way of the Guerneville branch, from Fulton to Guerneville
